args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploy of v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate ~18%. Remediated by rolling back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status verified: healthy in all regions with error rate ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback completed:**
- The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Verified post-rollback status: checkout-api is now **healthy in all three regions** with an error rate of ~0.2%.

**Incident opened:**
- Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", documenting the failure and remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 (and its staging-only sibling v2.3.1-rc) have never been healthy, so redeploying them would require change-manager approval per policy. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains for investigation.
